# Who Has the Power? Assignments, Paste-Ready

**Generated by `scripts/build-canvas-events.js`. Do not hand-edit.**
The overview, the questions and the success criteria are the same text the
online lesson shows, read out of the content module rather than retyped, so a student
cannot be assessed against a criterion they were never shown.

Topics with no entry here are done on paper and deliberately have no Canvas
assignment. A gradebook row nobody can submit to reads as missing work for the
whole class.

## Settings, the same for every one

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| Submission type | Online, then **Text Entry** |
| Attempts | Unlimited |
| Display grade as | Points |
| Peer review | Off |
| Anonymous grading | **Off** |

**Text Entry is required, not a default.** `scripts/parse-canvas-submissions.js`
reads the HTML body of a Text Entry submission. A file upload cannot be parsed
and will not appear in any analysis. **Anonymous grading must stay off**: it
suppresses the student name the parser uses, and the result is a run of
unattributable rows in `exceptions.csv`.
